title: X-CRISP: Domain-Adaptable and Interpretable CRISPR Repair Outcome Prediction
relevance_to_cellguide: Highly relevant to the plan's v3 'unseen-cell transfer' roadmap stage (§6.1): demonstrates transfer learning of a repair-outcome model pretrained on mESC data to NEW cell lines (K562, HAP1, U2OS) using as few as 50 target-domain samples, directly answering 'can the model generalize to a cell type absent during training' — the exact question the plan poses for v3, though for repair outcome rather than efficiency.
